title: Constraint: No Repeat in the Next 3 Draws
constraints: Values come from the tiny domain 0 … 4. Once drawn, a value may not appear again in the next 3 draws.
With only 5 values, every draw has at most 2 choices. The stream must still be random, not a fixed rotation.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Same history technique as the previous problem, but the domain is so small that the solver has at most two choices each time.
If you "solve" it with a counter (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 0, …), the transition statistics give you away.
